buy.name: Bull call spread
why: Regime read is HOLD (-9) → partly fits this bull structure (weight capped at 20 — the regime read has a weak track record).
IV30 ÷ realised vol = 1.30 → options look rich vs how the stock has actually moved; this structure is net short volatility (helps).

Model edge: if volatility ends up halfway between the market's 69% and the stock's recent realised 63% (= 66%), the expected profit of this trade is +$11 per contract (+10% of max risk), assuming zero price drift.
Probability of profit 33% on market-implied vol, 34% at realised vol.
Short strike(s) sit outside the ±1σ expected move (±$4.32 to expiry).
flags: Wide bid/ask on at least one leg (32% of mid) — expect to pay more than the mid price.
Earnings (2026-11-13) fall before this expiry: expect a gap and an implied-vol drop afterwards.
Short options can be assigned early (especially around dividends/expiry) and need margin; spreads are capped at the max loss shown.
